download_layout_models: download the docling layout model artifacts from Hugging Face Hub to a local directory
initialize_layout_predictor: initialize a LayoutModel with artifacts path and accelerator options for document layout analysis
run_layout_prediction: run layout prediction on a batch of document pages to detect text, tables, figures, and formulas
visualize_layout_clusters: visualize raw and postprocessed layout clusters side by side with bounding boxes and confidence scores
compute_layout_confidence: compute average layout and OCR confidence scores for a document page after layout postprocessing
